note: Seed facts for the recall eval. Targets are the salient facts (importance 3, except the keep-alive pair at 2); distractors share every token of one query but carry no answer, so they test ranking rather than matching. The keep-alive pair is the staleness fixture: the old fact is superseded, never deleted, and its validity window is backdated in the scratch DB so --as-of time travel is testable with fixed dates. No fact here is live data — these are eval fixtures for a scratch database only.
